note: USACE campground (Nashville District) on Lake Cumberland's main body near Somerset, under mature hardwoods. The lake-side row (sites 1-4, 13) sits on a bank about 5 m above the summer shoreline beside the campground's boat ramp, with open views over the lake; the upper sites are wooded. Site 16 takes only a small camper with no slides; some tent sites are up steps. --Claude
summary: Corps campground, rec.gov 232733: 22 sites (16 W/E 50A incl. pop-up-only 16, + tent), $30 RV (2027), season 2027 May 13 - Oct 17, weekend 2-night min, 14-night limit, showers/laundry/dump. WATERFRONT DOWN recommended: lakefront -> lakeview (every RV pad 4.6-10 m above summer pool; rec.gov's own site notes say 'Nice view').
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE RECOMMENDED: stored lakefront -> lakeview. Lake Cumberland summer pool 723 ft (220.4 m). 3DEP ring search from every RV site: the nearest, 01 (37.014853,-84.642130), sits at 225.0 m with the summer-pool line 15 m away - 4.6 m above it (~31%); 02/03/04 (37.014772,-84.642261 / 37.014678,-84.642357 / 37.014625,-84.642519) 225.5-226.8 m, pool at 20 m (5-6.4 m up); 13 230.6 m at 25 m; 06/07/08 225.4-228.9 m with the pool 10 m below a 5-8 m bank; 15-22 at 30-45 m and 7-9 m up through woods. Every pad is over the 1-2 m kayak test, matching the p3-590 Tailwater precedent (pads 4-6 m above water at 17-35 m = view). rec.gov's own site notices call 02 and 04 'Nice view of Lake Cumberland from this site'; its description says 'Eight of Waitsboro's sites are on the waterfront' and tags 01 (RV), 05 and 20 (tent) 'Lakefront'. Imagery (winter drawdown) shows open ground from the 01-04 row down to the shoreline beside the boat ramp, so the view holds. Old evidence ('site lane at top of drawdown band (summer-pool shoreline)') did not measure height. Suggested evidence: '3DEP 2026-11-24: RV pads 01-04 at 225.0-226.8 m, Lake Cumberland summer pool (220.4 m) 15-20 m away and 4.6-6.4 m below; 06-08 above a 5-8 m bank; rec.gov site notes 02/04 "Nice view of Lake Cumberland"; open slope on imagery = lakeview'.
